profile.visual_desc: Heavy bipedal robot with olive-drab plating and cobalt blue accents. Features red shoulder orbs and a large cylindrical top piece.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Emotionless metal faceplate featuring a single, glowing white horizontal optic slit and surrounding blue industrial piping.
profile.weapon_desc: Integrated optical energy projector housed within the central head unit.
profile.step1_ready: Neutral isometric stance facing down-right, legs planted firmly with arms at sides.
profile.step2_windup: The chassis locks into place as the central optic lens gathers yellow energy, brightening significantly.
profile.step3_impact: Discharges a wide, conical yellow energy beam from the eye downward toward the lower-right target area.
profile.step4_finish: The energy beam vanishes, leaving a brief jagged yellow flash on the ground before the unit resets.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The yellow energy beam correctly projects from the central eye slit downward at a diagonal angle toward the bottom-right.

evaluation.diagnosis: The sequence maintains consistent orientation and anatomical integrity. Beam VFX aligns with the eye slit and follows reference timing.
